t2.title: People be encouraged to use electric vehicles
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Should people be encouraged to use electric vehicles?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Electric vehicles are gaining popularity worldwide. I strongly believe governments should encourage people to switch to electric cars.

Firstly, EVs produce zero direct emissions, improving air quality. In cities suffering from pollution, widespread EV adoption could significantly reduce health problems like asthma and respiratory diseases.

Secondly, electric vehicles are cheaper to run. Electricity costs less than petrol, and EVs require less maintenance with fewer moving parts. Long-term savings offset higher purchase prices.

However, critics highlight charging infrastructure limitations. Range anxiety and long charging times concern many drivers. Additionally, battery production has environmental impacts.

Nevertheless, technology is advancing rapidly. Battery technology improves each year, extending range and reducing charging times. Governments can accelerate change through tax incentives, charging station investments, and phasing out petrol vehicles.

In conclusion, encouraging electric vehicle adoption is essential for sustainable transportation. With proper support, EVs will become the norm within decades.

t2.sampleA2:
Dear SparkleWash,


The car wash was good, and my car is very clean. The people were friendly, and I liked that. The waiting area was okay, but it was a bit cold.

t2.sampleB1:
Dear SparkleWash Team,


Thank you for the email. I recently used your premium car wash service, and I wanted to give you some feedback. Overall, I was quite satisfied with the cleaning quality. My car looked great afterwards. The customer service was also good; the staff were polite and helpful.


The waiting area was reasonably comfortable, but it could be improved. Perhaps some magazines or newspapers would be a nice addition. Also, I think you could offer a package that includes interior detailing. Many people would probably be interested in that.


In conclusion, I had a positive experience and would recommend SparkleWash to others.


Sincerely,
A Satisfied Customer
t2.sampleB2: Are Electric Cars the Future? Ten years ago, spotting an electric car was a real novelty. Today, they hum quietly down every street – and in my opinion, that is exactly how it should be. The clearest reason is the environment. Unlike petrol engines, which pump harmful fumes into the air we breathe, electric vehicles produce no exhaust at all. Encouraging drivers to make the switch would clean up our cities and help tackle climate change. Norway is a shining example: thanks to generous incentives, nearly every new car sold there is now electric. There are practical benefits too. Charging at home costs far less than filling up at the pump, and with fewer moving parts, electric cars rarely break down. Little by little, the savings really add up. Of course, critics point to steep price tags and too few charging points. These are fair worries, but prices are tumbling and stations are popping up everywhere. All things considered, I firmly believe governments should nudge people towards electric vehicles. The sooner we get on board, the brighter our future will look.
t2.uzSample:
Elektromobillar butun dunyoda ommalashib bormoqda. Men hukumatlar odamlarni elektromobillarga o'tishga undashi kerak, deb qat'iy ishonaman.

Birinchidan, elektromobillar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri chiqindilarni chiqarmaydi, bu esa havo sifatini yaxshilaydi. Ifloslanishdan aziyat chekayotgan shaharlarda elektromobillarni keng joriy etish astma va nafas olish yo'llari kasalliklari kabi sog'liq muammolarini sezilarli darajada kamaytirishi mumkin.

Ikkinchidan, elektromobillarni ishlatish arzonroq. Elektr energiyasi benzinga qaraganda arzonroq va elektromobillar kamroq harakatlanuvchi qismlar bilan kamroq texnik xizmat ko'rsatishni talab qiladi. Uzoq muddatli tejash yuqori xarid narxlarini qoplaydi.

Biroq, tanqidchilar zaryadlash infratuzilmasining cheklanganligini ta'kidlashadi. Masofa xavotiri va uzoq zaryadlash vaqti ko'plab haydovchilarni tashvishga solmoqda. Bundan tashqari, batareya ishlab chiqarishning atrof-muhitga ta'siri bor.

Shunga qaramay, texnologiya jadal rivojlanmoqda. Batareya texnologiyasi har yili yaxshilanib, masofani uzaytiradi va zaryadlash vaqtini qisqartiradi. Hukumatlar soliq imtiyozlari, zaryadlash stantsiyalariga investitsiyalar va benzinli transport vositalarini bosqichma-bosqich bekor qilish orqali o'zgarishlarni tezlashtirishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, elektromobillarni qabul qilishni rag'batlantirish barqaror transport uchun zarurdir. To'g'ri qo'llab-quvvatlash bilan elektromobillar o'n yillar ichida odatiy holga aylanadi.

Hurmatli SparkleWash jamoasi,


Elektron pochta xabaringiz uchun rahmat. Yaqinda sizning premium avtomobil yuvish xizmatingizdan foydalandim va sizga bir oz fikr-mulohaza bildirishni xohladim. Umuman olganda, tozalash sifati meni juda qoniqtirdi. Mashinam keyin ajoyib ko'rinishga ega bo'ldi. Mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatish ham yaxshi edi; xodimlar xushmuomala va yordam berishga tayyor edilar.


Kutish joyi yetarlicha qulay edi, lekin uni yaxshilash mumkin. Ehtimol, ba'zi jurnallar yoki gazetalar yaxshi qo'shimcha bo'lardi. Shuningdek, menimcha, siz ichki detallarni tozalashni o'z ichiga olgan paketni taklif qilishingiz mumkin. Ko'pchilik bundan manfaatdor bo'lishi mumkin.


Xulosa qilib aytganda, men ijobiy tajribaga ega bo'ldim va SparkleWashni boshqalarga tavsiya qilaman.


Hurmat bilan,
Qoniqish hosil qilgan mijoz
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli SparkleWash jamoasi,


Men sizning premium avtomobil yuvish xizmatidagi yaqinda bo'lgan tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, tozalashning puxtaligi va xizmat ko'rsatishning umumiy sifati meni hayratga soldi. Mening avtomobilim boshqa muassasalarga tashriflardan keyin ancha toza ko'rinishga ega bo'ldi.


Mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatish ham maqtovga sazovor edi; xodimlar e'tiborli bo'lishdi va mening savollarimga samarali javob berishdi. Biroq, kutish joyi, yetarli bo'lsa-da, ba'zi yaxshilanishlardan foyda ko'rishi mumkin. Ehtimol, o'rindiqlarni yaxshilash yoki bepul Wi-Fi taqdim etish mijozlar tajribasini oshirishi mumkin.


Qo'shimcha xizmatlarga kelsak, menimcha, keramik qoplama variantini taklif qilish uzoq muddatli bo'yoqni himoya qilishni istagan mijozlarga mos keladi. Bundan tashqari, bosqichma-bosqich imtiyozlarga ega sodiqlik dasturini joriy etish takroriy biznesni rag'batlantirishi mumkin. Nihoyat, men ishlatiladigan ekologik toza detarjanlarni qadrlasam ham, ehtimol, bu jihatni aniq reklama qilish atrof-muhitga e'tiborli iste'molchilarga yoqadi.


Fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish imkoniyati uchun rahmat. Kelajakda SparkleWashdan yana foydalanishni kutaman.


Hurmat bilan,
Otabek Nazarov

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the car wash service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear SparkleWash Team, Thank you for asking about my experience with your car wash service. I was thoroughly impressed with the results. My car looked absolutely spotless inside and out. Your staff were extremely professional and paid attention to every detail. The waiting area with free WiFi and coffee was a nice touch. However, I have some suggestions. The waiting time was rather long during weekends. Additionally, the pricing information for different packages wasn't clearly displayed. I would love to see a mobile app for booking appointments. A monthly subscription package for regular customers would be attractive. Also, offering eco-friendly cleaning options would appeal to environmentally conscious customers. Overall, SparkleWash provides excellent service. Yours sincerely, Otabek Nazarov
t12.sampleA1:
Hi SparkleWash,
The car is clean. Good.
Thank you.
Bye
t12.sampleA2:
Dear SparkleWash,

Thank you for the car wash. My car is clean now. The people are nice. But I waited a long time. The waiting room is okay, and the coffee is good. I think you should have more chairs. And maybe some magazines. Thank you.

From, Otabek Nazarov
t12.sampleB1:
Dear SparkleWash Team,

Thank you for your email. I wanted to tell you about my visit to your car wash. I think the cleaning was very good. My car looks very clean. The customer service was also good, the people were friendly. The waiting area was comfortable, but it was a little bit busy.

I think you could offer some different things. For example, maybe a special wash for people who come often. Also, it would be good if you had a place to charge my phone while I wait. Overall, I liked the service.

Sincerely,
Otabek Nazarov
t12.sampleB2: Dear SparkleWash Team, Thank you for getting in touch about my recent visit to your premium car wash. On the whole, I was very impressed. My car came back absolutely spotless, and your staff clearly took pride in their work, paying close attention to every last detail. The free coffee in the waiting area was a lovely touch as well. That said, I do have a couple of suggestions. The wait on Saturday was longer than I had hoped, so it might be worth letting customers book online to ease the pressure at busy times. I would also love to see an eco-friendly wash option, as more and more drivers now care about the environment. All in all, you offer a first-rate service, and these small changes would make it even better. I look forward to my next visit. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli SparkleWash jamoasi,

Avtomobil yuvish xizmatingizdan foydalanish tajribam haqida so‘raganingiz uchun rahmat.

Natijalardan juda ta’sirlandim. Mashinam ichkaridan ham, tashqaridan ham mutlaqo benuqson ko‘rinishga keldi. Xodimlaringiz juda professional edilar va har bir detalga e’tibor qaratishdi. Bepul WiFi va kofe bilan ta’minlangan kutish joyi juda yoqimli qo‘shimcha edi.

Biroq, mening ba’zi takliflarim bor. Dam olish kunlari kutish vaqti biroz uzoq bo‘ldi. Bundan tashqari, turli paketlar uchun narxlar haqidagi ma’lumotlar aniq ko‘rsatilmagan edi.

Uchrashuvlarni bron qilish uchun mobil ilova bo‘lishini juda xohlardim. Doimiy mijozlar uchun oylik obuna paketi jozibali bo‘lardi. Shuningdek, ekologik toza tozalash variantlarini taklif qilish atrof-muhitga befarq bo‘lmagan mijozlarga yoqadi.

Umuman olganda, SparkleWash a’lo darajadagi xizmat ko‘rsatadi.

Hurmat bilan,
Otabek Nazarov
t12.uzSampleA2:
Hurmatli SparkleWash,

Mashina yuvish xizmati uchun rahmat. Mashinam endi toza. Odamlar yaxshi. Lekin men uzoq kutdim. Kutish xonasi yaxshi, va kofe mazali. O'ylaymanki, sizda ko'proq stullar bo'lishi kerak. Va balki ba'zi jurnallar. Rahmat.

Kimdan, Otabek Nazarov
t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli SparkleWash jamoasi,

Elektron pochtangiz uchun rahmat. Men sizning avtomobillarni yuvish xizmatiga tashrifim haqida aytmoqchi edim. Menimcha, tozalash juda yaxshi bo'ldi. Mashinam juda toza ko'rinadi. Mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatish ham yaxshi edi, odamlar do'stona munosabatda bo'lishdi. Kutish joyi qulay edi, lekin biroz gavjum edi.

Menimcha, siz boshqa narsalarni taklif qilishingiz mumkin. Misol uchun, tez-tez keladigan odamlar uchun maxsus yuvish xizmati bo'lishi mumkin. Shuningdek, kutayotganimda telefonimni zaryad qilish uchun joy bo'lsa yaxshi bo'lardi. Umuman olganda, menga xizmat yoqdi.

Hurmat bilan,
Otabek Nazarov
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli SparkleWash jamoasi,

Avtomobil yuvish xizmatida yaqinda bo'lgan tajribam yuzasidan bildirilgan qiziqishingiz uchun rahmat. Sizga o'z fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozmoqdaman.

Umuman olganda, tozalash sifatidan qoniqdim. Tashqi yuvish ayniqsa samarali bo'ldi va mashinam keyin ancha toza ko'rindi. Mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatish ham samarali va xushmuomala edi. Biroq, kutish vaqti men kutganimdan biroz uzoqroq bo'ldi, hatto oldindan belgilangan vaqtim bo'lsa ham.

Takliflar nuqtai nazaridan, batafsil tozalash paketlarining kengroq assortimentini taklif qilish foydali bo'lishi mumkin, ehtimol ichki dog'larni olib tashlash yoki faralarni tiklash variantlarini ham qo'shish mumkin. Bundan tashqari, turli paket variantlari va ularning narxlari to'g'risida aniqroq ko'rsatmalar bo'lishi foydali bo'ladi. Tez-tez keladigan mijozlar uchun sodiqlik dasturi ham qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'lishi mumkin.

Umuman olganda, men SparkleWash qimmatli xizmat ko'rsatadi deb hisoblayman va bir nechta kichik o'zgartirishlar bilan u mijozlar uchun yanada jozibali bo'lishi mumkin.

Hurmat bilan,
Otabek Nazarov
